value: Catalogue generation g0004 lists one 36-byte file named known.txt in a 162-byte 7-Zip archive that j000145 created as a known-answer self-test from a literal test string; the archive is a validation fixture, not a supplied case artifact.
evidence: Read the complete g0004 member listing (one file, known.txt, size 36); j000145 sealed output includes selftest/known.7z and its complete test/extract logs; the j000145 command in its sealed run record states it writes `DFIR offline known-answer self-test` before creating the archive.
confidence_why: The catalogue listing directly identifies the sole member and size, and the successful job's recorded command and archived output establish generation as an explicit self-test. These are linked records of the same job, not independent sources.
indicates: The uncited object is synthetic validation output and not a new item of case evidence; it cannot resolve any investigative question.
alternatives_none_why: This is a provenance classification from the archive generation record and catalogue inventory, not an inference about a case artifact.

method.command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/official7zz.XXXXXX)
cp store/imports/mat-0001/out/7zz "$TMP/7zz"
chmod 700 "$TMP/7zz"
mkdir -p "$OUT/selftest/src" "$OUT/selftest/extracted"
printf 'DFIR offline known-answer self-test\n' > "$OUT/selftest/src/known.txt"
"$TMP/7zz" a -bd -y "$OUT/selftest/known.7z" "$OUT/selftest/src/known.txt" > "$OUT/selftest/create.txt"
"$TMP/7zz" t -bd "$OUT/selftest/known.7z" > "$OUT/selftest/test.txt"
"$TMP/7zz" x -bd -y "$OUT/selftest/known.7z" -o"$OUT/selftest/extracted" > "$OUT/selftest/extract.txt"
cmp "$OUT/selftest/src/known.txt" "$OUT/selftest/extracted/known.txt"
printf 'selftest_sha256=' > "$OUT/selftest/result.txt"; sha256sum "$OUT/selftest/extracted/known.txt" | awk '{print $1}' >> "$OUT/selftest/result.txt"
"$TMP/7zz" t -bd -slt store/jobs/j000067/out/contact.rar > "$OUT/contact-test-slt.txt"
mkdir -p "$OUT/contact"
"$TMP/7zz" x -bd -y store/jobs/j000067/out/contact.rar -o"$OUT/contact" > "$OUT/contact-extract.txt"
find "$OUT/contact" -type f -printf '%P\t%s\n' | sort > "$OUT/contact-files.tsv"
find "$OUT/contact" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$OUT/contact-sha256.txt"
"$TMP/7zz" i > "$OUT/7zz-info.txt"
cat "$OUT/selftest/result.txt"; tail -20 "$OUT/contact-test-slt.txt"; wc -l "$OUT/contact-files.tsv"
